parked_for: Prepositions of time 2 — not on the path yet. Do not invent a node until James asks.
why: Patrik: *3 times in week* → *a week*. Real L1 error, wrong unit. This pack is at / on / in. once/twice/three times a week is a zero-prep pattern (a day / a week / a year), not a fourth box.

accepts: I work two times a week.
items.explanation: **twice a week** — not *in week*. Czech *týdně* → **a week**.
items.explanation_cz: **twice a week** — ne *in week*. Česky *týdně* → **a week**.

items.en: I play tennis once a week.
accepts: I play tennis once a week.
items.explanation: **once a week** — not *in week*. Czech *týdně* → **a week**.
items.explanation_cz: **once a week** — ne *in week*. Česky *týdně* → **a week**.
